gui.justifylasers.powered.security_hint: Public: shared access. Private: owner only.
gui.justifylasers.powered.owner_only: Only the owner or an admin can change access.
gui.justifylasers.powered.security_scope: Protects controls, installed parts and player mining.
gui.justifylasers.powered.redstone_hint: Click to cycle: ignore / with signal / without signal.
gui.justifylasers.powered.redstone_energ: Blocked by redstone = no energy consumption.
gui.justifylasers.powered.preview_hint: Drag to rotate. Range: %s blocks. Thickness: %s×.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.crys: Install one color crystal. The emitter cannot run without it.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.silk: Silk Touch module. Configure in block destruction settings.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.drop: Block collection module. Enables normal block loot.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.scor: Scorch mark module. Surface marks also work without block destruction.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.igni: Ignition module. Configure in entity damage settings.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.mini: Block destruction module. Required for mining and its settings.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.dama: Entity damage module. Required for damage and its settings.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.rang: Tier I: +1 block and +1 %1$s/t each. Tier II: +8 blocks and +8 %1$s/t each. Stack: 64. Base range: 1; cap: 512 blocks. Loaded chunks only.
gui.justifylasers.powered.slot_hint.thic: Up to 64 thickness modules, +1 %s/t each. Empty: 0.1×. Full stack: 10×.
item.justifylasers.refocusing_cube.input: Five inputs · One output with a double brass rim
item.justifylasers.refocusing_cube.rotat: Sneak + right-click: rotate on the ground
item.justifylasers.refocusing_cube.colle: Sneak + attack: collect · Sprint + attack: stronger kick
message.justifylasers.cube_occupied: Another player is carrying this cube
death.attack.justifylasers.laser: %1$s was cut down by a laser
death.attack.justifylasers.laser.player: %1$s was cut down by a laser while fighting %2$s
gui.justifylasers.light_emission.tooltip: Beam and model-strip emission, colored lighting and reflections while shaders are enabled.
gui.justifylasers.minecraft_lighting.too: Vanilla Minecraft light around the emitter block (level 15). Independent of shader emission.
gui.justifylasers.mining_speed.tooltip: Minimum keeps the original hardness-based mining time. Maximum mines one breakable block per game tick (20 blocks/s at 20 TPS). Intermediate values shorten the mining time. Unbreakable blocks remain protected. Arrow keys adjust by one step.
gui.justifylasers.silk_touch.tooltip: Use vanilla Silk Touch loot where supported, such as stone, glass and ores. Requires block drops to be enabled.
gui.justifylasers.drop_blocks.tooltip: Drop mined blocks and their normal loot. When disabled, directly mined blocks drop no items or experience; container contents are also removed.
gui.justifylasers.scorch_marks.tooltip: Show surface burn marks from this emitter, including refocused beams. Works independently of block destruction. Disabling clears this emitter's existing marks.
gui.justifylasers.ignite_entities.toolti: Successful, unblocked hits ignite entities for up to 4 seconds. Adds normal fire damage; fire immunity and fire protection still apply. Requires Entity damage to be enabled.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.strength.tool: Output strength from 0 to 15. Applies to the five sides other than the optical input.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.inverted.tool: Normal: output while a matching laser is detected. Inverted: output when there is no matching laser. The master switch always disables output.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.filter.toolti: Accept any laser color or only the selected color. The model shows the incoming color even when the filter rejects it.
gui.justifylasers.receiver.emission.tool: Shader emission of the receiver's colored indicators while a beam reaches the front. Does not add Minecraft block light.
gui.justifylasers.damage_per_hit.tooltip: 0.1–20 HP per hit, before armor and other defenses. 2 HP = 1 heart. Use the arrow keys for fine adjustment.
gui.justifylasers.knockback.tooltip: 0–10× push per hit. 0× disables knockback; 1× is the original gentle push. Knockback resistance still applies.
gui.justifylasers.hits_per_second.toolti: 1–20 hits per 20 game ticks. 20/s hits every tick; 1/s hits once per second at 20 TPS. Lower server TPS slows the rate.
gui.justifylasers.beam_range.tooltip: 1–512 blocks along the entire beam path, including refocusing cubes. Only loaded chunks are traced. Arrow keys adjust by one block.
gui.justifylasers.module_hint: Install a crystal and the required modules.
